title: The Little Brother — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Spanish Italian language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual family portrait Zimbabwe-Australia character
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
He was the one who figured things out quietly.
He came home different.
Not dramatically — just in the way a person comes home
when they've understood something they can stop looking for.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Era el que resolvía las cosas en silencio. (He was the one who figured things out quietly.)
Volvió a casa diferente. (He came home different.)
No dramáticamente — solo de la manera en que una persona vuelve a casa (Not dramatically — just in the way a person comes home)
cuando han entendido algo que pueden dejar de buscar. (when they've understood something they can stop looking for.)
El hermano menor (The little brother)
Que resultó ser el que sabía. (Who turned out to be the one who knew.)
Joel — que entendió antes de explicarlo. (Joel — who understood before he explained it.)
El hermano menor lo hizo exactamente bien. (The little brother did exactly right.)

[Chorus - Italian, with English translations]
Il fratello minore (The little brother)
Che si è rivelato quello che sapeva (Who turned out to be the one who knew)
Il fratello minore (The little brother)
Che ha trovato lo Zimbabwe in Australia (Who found Zimbabwe in Australia)
Joel — che ha capito prima di spiegarlo (Joel — who understood before he explained it)
Joel — che è tornato a casa diverso (Joel — who came home different)
Il fratello minore (The little brother)
Ha fatto esattamente la cosa giusta (Did exactly right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The room had already decided. The good kind of obvious.
Spanish: La sala ya había decidido. El tipo bueno de obvio. (The room had already decided. The good kind of obvious.)
Italian: La stanza aveva già deciso. Il buon tipo di ovvio. (The room had already decided. The good kind of obvious.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Good one. The little brother did exactly right.
Spanish: Bien hecho. El hermano menor lo hizo exactamente bien. (Good one. The little brother did exactly right.)
Italian: Ben fatto. Il fratello minore ha fatto esattamente la cosa giusta. (Good one. The little brother did exactly right.)
